title: Chapter 59: The Purpose Of The Alliance
content:
Chapter 59: The Purpose Of The Alliance

"The Zerg is a newly born native race. You should know what it means to be born in this situation!"

"This means that the Zerg is a great heroic race! Much greater than those races that want to escape from the world!"

"I learned that the Zerg has the support of native powerful beings comparable to gods. His spokesperson Wu Qing established the Great Xia Territory!"

"The Great Xia Territory was just established and had a lot of work to do. It alone resisted the evil god camp's sweep of this area!"

"Everyone should have seen the record of the Great Xia Territory and the Zerg! They win every battle! The bear goblins dare not leave the city today!"

"But it is unrealistic to completely stop the evil god camp from invading this area by relying on the current Great Xia Territory alone. !”

“People must save themselves first, and then others will save them!”

“So, I was thinking, since the situation is already very bad, we might as well fight one last time!”

“I want to unite all our independent territories, each of which will play to its own strengths, form an alliance, and jointly defend our territories!”

“I told the visiting Lord Wu Qing of Daxia about my idea. He agreed with the proposal of the alliance, but was unwilling to come out to preside over the affairs of the alliance!”

“In the end, I can only volunteer to stand up and temporarily be responsible for contacting the four parties and presiding over the establishment of the alliance and other affairs!”

“Sincerely invite everyone to join this self-help alliance! This is why I invited everyone here today!”

Meng paused and looked around the audience when he said this.

All the lords stopped eating and listened to Meng quietly. No one stood up to support him, and no one expressed opposition. They all seemed relatively calm, as if waiting for the next words.

“Since we want to form an alliance, we must have the purpose of the alliance and some specific charters!”

Meng continued.

"Time is tight now, we don't have that much time to do these things, I just thought of a few points and put them out for everyone to discuss!"

"If it is feasible, we will build the alliance first!"

"If we are lucky enough to survive the disaster we are seeing, we will discuss the future of the alliance!"

"I know everyone has their own reasons and don't want to become a vassal of other territories, so the first principle of our alliance is: freedom to come and go!"

"We can freely choose whether to join the alliance! I promise here that I will never force any territory to join the alliance! Alliance establishment After rising up, I will never deliberately target territories that have not joined the alliance!"

"For territories that want to withdraw from the alliance after joining, I will not block them. As long as they clarify the responsibilities and rights with the alliance and do not deliberately take advantage of the alliance and then maliciously withdraw from the alliance, I can swear that I will never let anyone make things difficult for them!"

"But those who want to take advantage of the alliance and run away, you should also know my temper!"

"The ends of the earth! No matter how much it costs! I will find you!"

Meng clenched his fist, his knuckles crackled, and a fierce momentum was hidden!

"The second principle of the alliance is: fairness and impartiality!"

"In the alliance, everything requires fairness and impartiality. How much voice and benefits you can get depends on how much contribution you have made to the alliance!"

"There must be a reward for your efforts, and you cannot sit back and enjoy the fruits of your labor. This is the general principle!"

"As long as the territory participates in the affairs of the alliance, everyone must evaluate its contribution within the same set of rules, and the evaluation results will be recorded!"

"When everyone exercises power and divides benefits in the alliance, they will be distributed according to the amount of contribution to the alliance!"

"The third principle of the alliance is: help each other!"

"When the territory of a member of the alliance is attacked by the evil camp or other enemies, all members of the alliance must provide unconditional support!"

"This unconditional support has a prerequisite, which must be that you are attacked without reason, or It was commissioned by the alliance to provoke and attack other enemies to cause the attack!"

"If the alliance is deliberately concealed and the war is privately provoked, the alliance can choose whether to support it according to the situation!"

"If the alliance suffers losses as a result, the relevant territories must bear the responsibility!"

"The support strength of each territories in the alliance can be determined according to the nature of the war. For example, for enemies with low threat levels to the alliance and related territories, each territory can decide the support strength on its own."

"In the case of a war like the invasion of the evil god camp, the alliance can agree on a war damage standard. Territories that do not meet this war damage standard must continue to participate in the war!"

"When the war damage of a territory reaches the agreed war damage standard, each territory can decide whether to continue to participate in the war!"

After Meng finished talking about these three alliance purposes, he looked at the lords present, and most of them were tempted.

"I can think of these three for now. You can discuss and see what opinions you have!"

"If you have any good ideas, you can also bring them up and we will discuss them together!"

"No matter what! This alliance must be established today!"

"I, the Tiger Lord, and Wu Qing's Great Xia Lord, will take the lead in joining!"

Meng expressed his attitude and sat down. He grabbed a large piece of meat and continued to eat.

Except Wu Qing, the other lords, according to their own situations and ideas, were silent in thought, some communicated with each other, and some interacted with each other with their eyes.

"This alliance now has only three framework purposes, and many details have not been perfected. There are still certain variables in the future. Do you want to join?"

"Based on the third alliance principle alone, we should join! Our small territories can't even handle a small army raid from the evil god camp. If we don't join the alliance, we will die!"

"Besides, I believe in Lord Meng's character! The first and second principles of the alliance will definitely be fulfilled seriously!"

"We don't join the Tengu clan for our own objective reasons, and many of them are lucky, thinking that they dare not do anything in the same camp!"

"The territories that resolutely refused to join the Tengu clan at the beginning, even if they want to join now, they can only be cannon fodder, which is meaningless! This is why everyone insists on not joining and maintaining an independent territory, right?!"

"Now there is another opportunity in front of us. If we don't have to be independent, we can join the Tengu clan. But there is no reason, so don't be reserved!"

"We all know Lord Meng, and I have a good impression of Lord Wu Qing of Daxia. He is a person worth making friends with!"

"Everyone has seen the performance of the Zerg during this period. Without their efforts, many lords present here would not have the opportunity to appear here today!"

"I decided to join the alliance. Even if the worst result is, it will not be worse than joining the Tengu clan!"

"I am optimistic about the development of the alliance. Lord Meng is a man who can do great things! I choose to join!"

"I am optimistic about Lord Daxia and the Zerg behind him! I choose to join!"

"..."

After some discussion, many lords of small territories directly decided to join the alliance.
